messages:
maya: CI started failing on master after the poetry.lock bump, looks related to tokenizers/transformers deps. tests erroring during wheel install. tagging sec since this might be a CVE fallout.

alex: saw this in the infra pipeline too, reprod locally with py3.10 in a clean venv. failure shows: `ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers` then downstream import failures in our CLI tests.

ci-bot: build 5478 failed on linux-x86-64 (ubuntu-22.04). Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/5478 (short link).

maya: the new lock pulled tokenizers 0.14.0 and starlette 0.22.0. we previously pinned tokenizers to 0.12.x in prod-image.

randall: security-oncall: quick context — there's an advisory out for tokenizers (moderate severity) about wheel compatibility leading to malformed builds on some pip versions. not an RCE, but breaks packaging which can cascade into CI/upgrade failures. confirm if advisory matches the exact version.

tori: can we temporarily pin tokenizers back to 0.12.1 in poetry.lock and rerun CI? quick revert strategy: `git checkout -b hotfix/poetry-lock-tokenizers && poetry add tokenizers@0.12.1 --lock` then open PR with changelog note.

alex: i tried that locally, `poetry add tokenizers@0.12.1 --lock` regenerates lock and tests pass for the CLI unit tests. integration suite still flakes in one case but unrelated.

maya: proposed plan: 1) create hotfix branch that pins tokenizers to 0.12.1 and starlette to previous safe patch if needed, 2) run matrix CI (py3.9-3.11) in the PR, 3) merge and cut a minor zero-downtime release for our infra images and the public SDK.

randall: priority: high for CI stability and to unblock other teams. security rating: low-medium; no customer data exposure observed. timeline: aim to merge within 6 hours, rollback if any test regression. also file an internal advisory linking to upstream CVE thread.

security-oncall: please capture the advisory ID in the PR description and add a note to the vuln tracker. if upstream issues a patched wheel, we should plan to upgrade and run reproducer tests.

maya: adding the reproducer script to the PR:```bash
# reproducer
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
pip install tokenizers==0.14.0
python -c "import tokenizers; print(tokenizers.__version__)"
```

alex: CI workflow tweak suggestion (short-term): add a job step that pins pip to 23.3 and forces wheel builds for tokenizers to catch install-time failures earlier:```yaml
- name: Ensure pip/wheel
  run: |
    pip install pip==23.3 wheel
    python -m pip install -e .[dev]
```

tori: i'll open the hotfix PR now and @randall will add the vuln tracker entry. can we also notify the SDK teams to avoid upgrading their lockfiles until we confirm upstream patch?

randall: will do. tagging #platform-notify with the TL;DR and ETA after PR is open. also assigning oncall to monitor rollouts.

maya: thanks — if everyone agrees, hotfix + CI tweak as a stopgap, then follow-up to bump to upstream patched wheel once available. I'll post PR link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pull/3991 by tori (hotfix/poetry-lock-tokenizers)

maya: PR linked. running the 3-matrix now. ping me for any flaky failures and i'll bisect further.
file_notes: thread about triage and hotfix for tokenizers/poetry.lock causing CI breakages; contains commands and CI snippets
